rows.description: Open-source Windows game resource manager. Suppresses background processes, gives games exclusive CPU cores, steers device interrupts off game cores, applies per-game GPU driver, memory and power policies, and restores every change after play. No injection, no telemetry. GPL-3.0.
RyTuneX is an advanced system tuning engine built with WinUI 3 and .NET, designed to debloat, optimize, and maximize performance on Windows 10 and 11.
A tiny helper application to force Windows 10 to use your preferred web browser instead of ignoring the setting to promote Microsoft Edge. Only runs for a microsecond when needed.
